_opis: Tooltips in English. Same keys and fields as podpowiedzi.pl.json; a missing entry or field falls back to Polish.

wspolne.suwak.uwaga: Double-click restores the default · the mouse wheel changes the value

edycja.kadrowanie.opis: Shows the crop frame on the photo. Drag the edges or corners to change the crop; drag outside the frame to rotate the photo.
edycja.kadrowanie.uwaga: R toggles · Shift keeps the ratio · Enter or Esc finishes

edycja.obrot_180.opis: Turns the photo upside down. Useful when the camera recorded the wrong orientation.

edycja.wyzeruj_kadr.opis: Restores the full frame and zeroes the straightening angle. The 90° rotation and other edits stay.

edycja.automatycznie.opis: Sets exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks and vibrance from the histogram. White balance is left alone. Tip: treat the result as a starting point and refine it with the sliders.

edycja.wyzeruj.opis: Returns every edit of this photo to its default, including crop and rotation.

suwak.rotation.opis: Straightens a tilted horizon by rotating the photo by any angle up to ±45°. Tip: it is easier to hit by dragging outside the frame in crop mode.

suwak.temperature.opis: Warms or cools the colors. The starting point is the white balance recorded by the camera. Tip: shots in shade or under clouds usually gain from a warmer tone, shots under light bulbs from a cooler one.
suwak.temperature.uwaga_suwaka: Double-click returns to the camera setting · the mouse wheel changes the value

suwak.temperature_jpeg.opis: In a JPEG the kelvins are nominal: the file carries no camera data, so the slider shifts the color relative to what the file holds.

suwak.tint.opis: Shifts colors between green and magenta. Tip: removes the green cast of fluorescent and LED light; a few points are usually enough.

suwak.exposure.opis: Brightens or darkens the whole photo. The unit is EV: +1 is twice the light. Tip: set it first, highlights and shadows afterwards.

suwak.contrast.opis: Increases or reduces the difference between light and dark areas. Negative values give a soft, matte image, positive ones a punchy one. Tip: in fog or overcast start at +15 to +30.

suwak.highlights.opis: Darkens or brightens the light areas without touching the shadows. Tip: negative values recover detail in the sky and bright clouds.

suwak.shadows.opis: Brightens or darkens the dark areas without touching the highlights. Tip: positive values bring out detail in backlit shots, but at high ISO they also reveal noise.

suwak.whites.opis: Moves the brightest tones of the photo. Tip: raise until the brightest spots are almost white; the photo gains sparkle, but too much burns out detail.

suwak.blacks.opis: Moves the darkest tones of the photo. Tip: slightly negative values add depth, positive ones turn black into matte grey.

suwak.vibrance.opis: Boosts mainly the muted colors and barely touches those already strong. Tip: gentler than saturation; +10 to +30 is usually enough.

suwak.saturation.opis: Strengthens or weakens all colors equally; −100 gives a black-and-white image. Tip: with positive values watch skin and reds, they oversaturate first.

suwak.sharpen_amount.opis: Strength of sharpening. RAW starts at 40, as in Lightroom; JPEG at 0, because the camera has already sharpened it. Tip: judge the effect at 100 % zoom.

suwak.sharpen_radius.opis: Width of the sharpened edges in pixels. Tip: for fine detail (leaves, hair) use 0.5–1, for portraits and soft edges above 1.5.

suwak.sharpen_detail.opis: How strongly fine textures are sharpened compared with clear edges. Tip: high values bring out texture, but also noise, so keep them low at high ISO.

suwak.sharpen_masking.opis: Limits sharpening to clear edges and spares smooth areas such as sky or skin. Tip: for portraits and high ISO try 30–60.

suwak.noise_luminance.opis: Suppresses grainy noise, matching its strength to the noise measured in this photo. It suppresses rather than smooths: fine grain remains. Tip: from ISO 3200 start at 30–50.
suwak.noise_luminance.uwaga: The preview refreshes a moment after you release the slider

suwak.noise_color.opis: Removes multicolored specks in shadows and smooth areas. The default 25 suits most photos. Tip: raise it when colored dots show in dark areas; too much blurs small colored details.
suwak.noise_color.uwaga: The preview refreshes a moment after you release the slider

podglad.powiekszenie.opis: Sets the preview zoom. Tip: judge sharpness and noise at 100 % or more.
podglad.powiekszenie.uwaga: The mouse wheel over the photo zooms too

podglad.dopasuj.opis: Shows the whole photo in the window.

podglad.sto.opis: One photo pixel is one screen pixel. Sharpness and noise show best at this zoom.

podglad.przed_po.opis: Hold to see the photo without edits; release to return.

podglad.metadane_rozwin.opis: Expands the panel with all the photo's metadata (EXIF), which can also be corrected here.

okno.eksportuj.opis: Saves the selected photos with their edits to JPEG, PNG or TIFF files. The originals stay untouched.

okno.filtr.opis: Shows all photos in the strip, RAW files only or JPEG files only. Handy in folders with thousands of files.

okno.przerwij.opis: Stops the running export. Files already written stay on disk.

mapa.przypisz.opis: Turns on assign mode: select photos in the list and click a place on the map, and all selected photos get those coordinates. Click the button again to leave the mode.
mapa.przypisz.uwaga: Coordinates go into the sidecar, and into the file only on export

mapa.usun.opis: Removes the coordinates from the selected photos. The photo file stays untouched.

mapa.pokaz_wszystkie.opis: Pans and zooms the map so that all pins are visible.

exif.Copyright.opis: Information about the rights to the photo.

exif.ImageDescription.opis: What the photo shows. Read by most viewers and photo services.

exif.XPKeywords.opis: Tags to find the photo by. Visible in the file properties in Windows.

exif.XPSubject.opis: Subject of the photo, visible in the file properties in Windows.

exif.DateTimeOriginal.opis: When the photo was taken; albums and Google Photos build their timeline from it. Tip: correct it when the camera clock was set wrong.

exif.DateTimeDigitized.opis: When the image was stored digitally. In a camera it is usually the moment of the shot; for a scanned print, the scan date.

exif.DateTime.opis: When the file was last changed. Programs usually set it themselves.

exif.LensModel.opis: Name of the lens. The program cannot read it from RW2 files; type it in if it should go into the export.

exif.BodySerialNumber.opis: Serial number of the camera body. Tip: clear it before publishing if you don't want the photos to be linked to your camera.

exif.Software.opis: The program that last saved the file.

exif.ISOSpeedRatings.uwaga: EXIF: ISOSpeedRatings · just the number, e.g. 3200

exif.FNumber.uwaga: EXIF: FNumber · just the number, e.g. 5.6

exif.ExposureTime.opis: How long the shutter was open.
exif.ExposureTime.uwaga: EXIF: ExposureTime · fraction or seconds, e.g. 1/250 or 2

exif.FocalLength.opis: Actual focal length of the lens, not converted to full frame.

exif.Orientation.opis: How to rotate the image when displaying it. Change it only when other programs show the photo askew; to rotate in Punctum use the rotate buttons.

exif.wszystkie_tagi.opis: Shows every tag stored in the file, including those that cannot be edited here.

exif.wyczysc.opis: Undoes the changes in this panel that have not been saved yet.

exif.zapisz_oryginal.opis: Writes the metadata straight into the JPEG file. Only the header changes; the image and the file date stay the same. For other formats metadata goes into the file on export.

ustawienia.silnik_auto.opis: The program picks the graphics card by itself, and the CPU when the card does not work.

ustawienia.silnik_gpu.opis: The graphics card computes the preview, so the sliders respond at once.

ustawienia.silnik_cpu.opis: The CPU computes the preview. It is slower; choose it when the graphics card causes trouble (black image, errors).

ustawienia.rozmiar_podgladu.opis: Long edge of the image computed for the fit-to-window view. Larger gives a sharper preview but slower sliders. Tip: set at least your monitor width.

ustawienia.watki.opis: How many thumbnails are computed at once when opening a folder. More is faster but loads the computer more.

ustawienia.opoznienie_ostrosci.opis: This many milliseconds after the view stops, a full-resolution detail is added. Shorter: sharp sooner, but more computing while panning.

ustawienia.opoznienie_szumu.opis: How long to wait after a slider move before preview noise reduction starts. It runs on the CPU, so on a slower computer too short a time slows the sliders down.

ustawienia.odszumianie_podgladu.opis: Precision of noise reduction in the preview and in the sharp detail when zoomed in. The fast variant is enough for setting sliders; export has its own setting.

ustawienia.podglad_pikseli.opis: Above this zoom you see real pixels, without smoothing. Useful for judging noise and sharpness.

ustawienia.nawigator.opis: Shows a thumbnail of the whole photo in the left panel, with a frame around the visible part. Click or drag to move elsewhere.

ustawienia.podpowiedzi.opis: Shows bubbles like this one when you hover over a button or slider. Turn them off once you know the program by heart.

ustawienia.opoznienie_podpowiedzi.opis: How long the cursor has to rest over a button or slider before the bubble appears. Shorter means faster bubbles, but they pop up more often during ordinary mouse moves.

ustawienia.blokada_kolka.opis: After scrolling the list, sliders ignore the wheel for this long, so scrolling the panel does not change values by accident.

ustawienia.zatrzymanie_kolka.opis: The cursor has to rest over a slider this long before the wheel changes it. Guards against a slider that slid under a still cursor by itself.

ustawienia.format.opis: Default export format. JPEG for viewing and publishing; PNG and TIFF are lossless but large, best for further editing.

ustawienia.jakosc_jpeg.opis: Compression level. At 90–95 there is practically no visible difference from the original and files stay reasonably small; 100 gives large files with no visible gain.

ustawienia.dluzszy_bok.opis: Downsizes the photo so that the long edge has at most this many pixels. Tip: 2048–2560 px is enough for the web.

ustawienia.odszumianie_eksportu.opis: Precision of noise reduction in the output files. The precise variant takes longer, but the difference shows at full resolution.

ustawienia.katalog.opis: Exported files go here by default. When the field is empty, the program asks for a folder on every export.

ustawienia.autor.opis: Suggested in the export window. Whether it goes into the files is decided on each export.

ustawienia.prawa.opis: Suggested in the export window. Whether it goes into the files is decided on each export.

ustawienia.jezyk.opis: Language of labels, tooltips and numbers. The list comes from the translation files, so a new language shows up here by itself once its file is added.
ustawienia.jezyk.uwaga: The change takes effect after restarting the program.

ustawienia.ostatni_folder.opis: After starting, the program immediately opens the folder you last worked in.

ustawienia.xmp.opis: Each photo's edits go into an XMP file next to the original and return to the sliders the next time it is opened, so editing a large folder can be spread over several days. The photo file is never changed.

ustawienia.domyslne.opis: Sets every field in this window to its factory value. They are saved only after you click “Save”.

eksport.katalog.opis: The files from this export go here.

eksport.podfolder.opis: Saves the files in a subfolder of this name, created in the destination folder, so the export does not mix with the originals.

eksport.istniejace.opis: What to do when the folder already has a file of that name: ask, replace it, skip the photo or pick a new name.

eksport.nazwa_oryginalna.opis: The output file keeps the original's name with a new extension, e.g. P1010203.jpg.

eksport.nazwa_numer.opis: All files get a common name and a running number, e.g. Holidays-001.jpg.

eksport.tekst.opis: The part of the name before the number.

eksport.numer_poczatkowy.opis: Counting starts from this number. Tip: when adding photos to an earlier export, start from the first free number.

eksport.cyfry.opis: How many digits the number has; empty places are filled with zeros (3 → 001), so the files sort in the right order.

eksport.format.opis: Format of the files from this export. JPEG for viewing and publishing; PNG and TIFF are lossless but large, best for further editing.

eksport.jakosc_jpeg.opis: Compression level for this export. At 90–95 there is practically no visible difference from the original and files stay reasonably small; 100 gives large files with no visible gain.

eksport.dluzszy_bok.opis: Downsizes the photos from this export so that the long edge has at most this many pixels. Tip: 2048–2560 px is enough for the web.

eksport.odszumianie.opis: Precision of noise reduction for this export. The precise variant takes longer, but the difference shows at full resolution.

eksport.autor.opis: Check to write the author into the files. The value comes from Settings ▸ Export; a change in this window applies to this export only and takes precedence over the field saved with the photo.

eksport.prawa.opis: Check to write the copyright into the files. The value comes from Settings ▸ Export; a change in this window applies to this export only and takes precedence over the field saved with the photo.

eksport.slowa.opis: Added to every file, next to the keywords saved with the photo.

eksport.temat.opis: Written into all files from this export; takes precedence over the subject saved with the photo. Not remembered between exports.

eksport.komentarz.opis: Written into all files from this export; takes precedence over the comment saved with the photo. Not remembered between exports.
